public/maps/index.json: A branching canyon through a red desert plain. Enemies walk the canyon floor, towers stand on the mesas; the HQ is a temple ruin by an oasis.
A colony where two canyons meet. Enemies walk the canyon floors, towers stand on the benches and mesas above.
A downtown after the end: three columns come down the avenues to the survivors' barricaded crossroads. Build on the corners and in the fallen blocks.
A mirrored coop map at dusk: two castles, two lanes each through the bailey, one shared HQ in the middle. Four spawns.
A port on a bay at dusk. Three columns come down the streets to the HQ on the waterfront, between quay, cranes and the container yard.
A research station in a crater on the Moon. Rover tracks wind between the craters from three landing zones; build on the rims.
A road spirals down a volcano's crater to the HQ on an obsidian island in a lava lake. Three spawns on the outer slopes join the spiral.
